detail.overviewText: The Bachelor of Accounting and Finance (Honours) programme at SEGi University is meticulously designed for individuals aspiring to excel in the dynamic fields of accounting and finance. Our comprehensive curriculum equips you with the knowledge and skills necessary to thrive in the industry and become a qualified accountant. One of the standout features of this programme is its industry relevance and integration of cutting-edge technologies. You won’t just learn theory; you’ll work on real industry projects through our unique “Industry into Classroom” approach. This means your coursework and assignments come directly from industry demands, providing you with invaluable hands-on experience and mentorship from both academic experts and industry practitioners. Furthermore, our programme offers paper exemptions for professional exams such as ACCA and CIMA, giving you a significant advantage in your career journey. With a diverse student community representing over 90 nationalities, you’ll also gain international exposure and networking opportunities, enhancing your global perspective. Join us to develop strong commercial awareness, financial management skills, and a solid foundation for a successful career in finance. Prepare to take your place in this competitive industry as a financial accountant, financial analyst, tax advisor, internal auditor, or pursue further studies in financial management or accounting.

Accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency and the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia, and recognised by the Board of Architects, Malaysia, this course instils not only technical prowess in design and building technology but also a deep understanding of cultural contexts and sustainability. This degree programme, taught by lecturers with significant industry experience, covers a comprehensive curriculum including Architecture Principles, Environmental Psychology, and Advanced Computer Modelling. A unique feature is the ‘Industry into Classroom’ initiative, where students undertake real industry projects under the guidance of both academic tutors and industry practitioners, ensuring graduates are industry-ready. With SEGi University’s commitment to diversity, students benefit from the rich tapestry of cultures shared by peers from over 90 nationalities, enhancing their learning experience and providing an invaluable international perspective. The programme prepares students for a range of careers in the interior architecture field, from technical assistants to project managers, ensuring they are wellequipped to meet the demands of this dynamic profession.

detail.overviewText: The Bachelor of Computer Science (Honours) at SEGi University offers a 3-year programme with specialisations designed to prepare students for diverse career opportunities in the ever-evolving field of IT. Students can choose to specialise in one of four areas: Artificial Intelligence: Gain a deep understanding of AI, covering machine learning, natural language processing, robotics, and decision-making systems, along with practical applications and mathematical foundations. Digital Transformation: Learn to integrate digital technology into businesses for enhanced efficiency, productivity, and innovation, focusing on electronic design automation (EDA) and semiconductor manufacturing. Cybersecurity: Develop robust technical and problem-solving skills to safeguard systems, networks, and data from cyber threats, with opportunities for professional certifications. Data Science: Delve into the multidisciplinary field of data science, extracting insights through statistical and computational methods, including data collection, analysis, modeling, and communication, with broad industry applications. SEGi University offers state-of-the-art facilities, collaboration with industry partners, and experienced academic faculty with industry backgrounds. Our unique “Industry into Classroom” approach provides students with real-life industry projects, offering a practical learning experience. With a diverse student community representing over 90 nationalities, SEGi University fosters international exposure and networking.

detail.overviewText: The Bachelor of Education (Hons) at SEGi University is a distinguished undergraduate programme dedicated to nurturing aspiring educators, equipping them with the essential skills and knowledge for a fulfilling career in education. Throughout this programme, students delve into the foundational principles of education, psychology, curriculum development, and gain invaluable practical experience in real classrooms, preparing them to become highly effective educators. Graduates of this programme emerge with a profound understanding of teaching methodologies, technology integration, and diverse instructional strategies, poised to make a profound impact on their students’ intellectual growth and character development, thus shaping the future through education. One remarkable feature of this programme is the opportunity to choose from five specialisations: Guidance and Counselling, Special Needs Education, TESL (Teaching English as a Second Language), Early Childhood Education and Chinese Education. This unique approach allows students to tailor their education to their specific interests and career aspirations. Accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency and the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia, this programme stands as a testament to SEGi University’s commitment to providing a world-class education

detail.overviewText: The Bachelor of International Business (Honours) – 2u1i at SEGi University is designed to produce future-ready professionals with both academic knowledge and real-world experience. This uniquely structured programme integrates two years of on-campus learning with one full year of structured work-based learning (WBL), preparing students to thrive in global and cross-cultural business environments. The curriculum covers key areas such as international trade, digital commerce, global market strategy, cross-cultural management, and sustainability. Through our strong industry collaborations, students gain hands-on exposure and networking opportunities with leading organisations—both locally and internationally. What is 2u1i? 2u1i is a strategic learning model where students spend 2 years at university and 1 year in the industry. At SEGi, this means: Year 1: Academic learning Year 2: Three semesters of WBL (structured industry training) Year 3: Advanced modules + final WBL semester Eligible diploma holders or working adults (via APEL C) may enter directly into Year 2 or 3. Programme Highlights Work-Based Learning (WBL): A full year of structured practical training across international operations, digital commerce, and global marketplaces. Globally Aligned Modules: Focused on international business, marketing, finance, sustainability, and cross-cultural leadership. Future-Ready Learning: Aligned with Industry 4.0—equipping students with global thinking, digital literacy, and business agility. APEL & Diploma Entry Options: Flexibility for working adults and diploma graduates to fast-track completion. International Exposure: Collaborations with global companies and international academic articulation.

detail.overviewText: The Bachelor of Mass Communication (Hons) programme at SEGi University is an exciting journey into the dynamic world of mass media. Mass communication is a vital discipline in today’s interconnected world, encompassing newspapers, magazines, radio, television, and film. This programme equips students with the kills and theoretical knowledge needed to excel in this field. What sets our programme apart is its blend of creativity and management. Students gain hands-on experience with state-of-the-art equipment and industry-relevant software. One unique aspect of this programme is the opportunity to specialise in Advertising, Broadcasting, or Public Relations, tailoring your education to your specific interests and career goals. With a curriculum designed to provide an in-depth exploration of subject matters and a range of electives, you’ll gain a comprehensive understanding of mass communication. Industry relevance is a priority at SEGi. Through our “Industry into Classroom” approach, students work on real industry projects, mentored by academic and industry experts. With students from over 90 nationalities, you’ll also benefit from a diverse and international learning environment. Accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency and the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia, this rogramme opens doors to a world of opportunities in mass communication

With a diverse student community representing over 90 nationalities, SEGi fosters international exposure and networking opportunities. Accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency and the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia, this programme opens doors to various career opportunities in industries such as aerospace, automotive, renewable energy, and more

accordionSections.Entry requirements: ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS As of 17th December 2019, the Malaysian Medical Council (MMC) had adopted the following Minimum Criteria & Qualification for the entry into Medical Programmes in Malaysia. ACADEMIC REQUIREMENTS All applicants who enter a matriculation, foundation or pre-medical programme, except those with a degree qualification in the arts of humanities, shall have passed and attained a minimum of the following at School Certificate level or its equivalent: Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia (SPM) with 5 Bs each in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics (or Additional Mathematics), and another subject, OR General Certificate of Education Ordinary “O-Levels” with 5 Bs each in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics (or Additional Mathematics), and another subject. All applicants with a Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) who enter a matriculation, foundation or pre-medical programme, except those with a degree qualification in arts or humanities, shall have passed and attained a minimum of B4 each in 3 subjects. Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) with B4 each in 3 subjects in Biology, Chemistry, Physics (or Mathematics or Additional Mathematics). All applicants, except those with a degree qualification in the arts or humanities, shall have passed and attained a minimum of the following at: a) Higher School Certificate or its equivalent: Sijil Tinggi Pelajaran Malaysia (STPM); grades BBB, ABC or AAC in 3 subjects i.e. Biology, and Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, OR GCE A-Levels; grades BBB, ABC or AAC in 3 subjects i.e. Biology, and Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, OR Matriculation, Foundation in Science, Pre-Medical Course; CGPA 3.0 (out of 4) in 3 subjects i.e. Biology, and Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, provided no score for any subject is less than C (GPA 2.0) and provided the course in not less than 1 year in the same accredited institution and the minimum entry qualification is 5 Bs each in Biology, and Chemistry, and Physics, and Mathematics (or Additional Mathematics), and another subject at School Certificate level or its equivalent, OR United Education Certificate (UEC); B4 each in 5 subjects i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, and Additional Mathematics, OR Monash University Foundation Pre-University Programme (MUFY), University of New South Wales (UNSW) Foundation, Western Australia Curriculum Council, HSC Sydney Australia, Trinity College Foundation Studies, Australian Universities Foundation Programmes, South Australian Matriculation (SAM), Victorian Certificate of Education Australia Year 12, Australian Matriculation (AUSMAT); aggregate or the equivalent of B in 3 subjects i.e. Biology, and Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics; or 80% ATAR provided the subjects include Biology, Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, OR National Certificate of Educational Achievement (NCEA) level 3 or New Zealand Bursary, average of 80% in any 3 subjects i.e. Biology, and Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, OR Canadian Pre-University (CPU) or Canadian International Matriculation Program (CIMP/Canadian Grade 12/13) or Ontario Secondary School Diploma Grade 12; average of 80% in 3 subjects i.e. Biology, and Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, OR Indian Pre-University; average 70% in 3 subjects i.e. Biology, and Chemistry, and Physics or Mathematics, OR International Baccalaureate; 30 points with a minimum of 2 science subjects or Mathematics at Higher Level (HL) and 1 science subject at Standard Level and attained a minimum score of 4 each in Biology, and Chemistry, and Physics (or Mathematics). OR b) Diploma Level Diploma in Health Science; CGPA 3.5 (out of 4), and provided the course is not less than 5 semesters or 2½ years in the same accredited institution and the minimum entry qualification is 2 Bs in Biology, and/or Chemistry, and/or Physics and 3 credits each in English, and Mathematics (or Additional Mathematics), and another subject at School Certificate Level or its equivalent. OR c) Degree Level: Degree in Health or Pure or Applied Sciences; CGPA 3.0 (out of 4), 5-year medical programme, OR Degree in Health or Pure or Applied Sciences; CGPA 3.3 (out of 4), 4-year graduate entry medical programme, OR Degree in the Arts of Humanities; CGPA 3.5 (out of 4), 5-year medical programme, OR Degree in the Arts of Humanities; CGPA 3.75 (out of 4), 4-year graduate entry medical programme. Language Requirements All applicants shall have attained a level of competence in English to enable them to complete the course successfully. Graduates from a medical programme who seek employment in the public sector shall attain a credit in Bahasa Malaysia and English at SPM or its equivalent. Other Requirements Applicants shall be required to undergo an aptitude test and/or an interview and/or a university entrance examination. Clarification In the event that there are any doubts, or there are no provisions in this guideline, prospective students are encouraged to seek clarification from the Malaysian Medical Council (MMC), www.mmc.gov.my .

After completion of the housemanship, you may undertake postgraduate specialist degree programme in an area of medicine according to your preferred choice of career path which will become apparent as you progress through the five-year MBBS programme.

detail.overviewText: There are two phases in the curriculum; the Medical Sciences Phase (Phase 1) which is the first two years of study, and the Clinical Phase (Phase 2) which is carried out in three subsequent years of study. Each phase is strategised to have four blocks and the modules/postings are repackaged and rearranged as follows. The Medical Sciences Phase, also known as the Pre-clinical Phase, consists of four blocks which are Block 1 (Foundation in Medical Sciences), block 2 (Introduction to Behavioural Science, Clinical, and Community Medicine), block 3 (System-Based Medical Sciences I), and block 4 (System-Based Medical Sciences II). The Clinical Phase also comprises 4 Blocks which spans over 3 years. These blocks are designated as Block 5 (Junior Clerkship), block 6 (Specialty Clerkship I), block 7 (Specialty Clerkship II), and Block 8 (Senior Clerkship). For the contents of each block, please refer to the modules below. Throughout the 5 years of study, subjects on soft skills development are also incorporated such as communication skills, behavioural science, team building, critical thinking, problem-solving, leadership, and management. The SEGi MBBS programme is internationally established and recognised by the various medical councils and regulatory bodies around the world including Malaysia, Thailand, Pakistan, Qatar and Maldives.

The programme is a testament to SEGi’s commitment to excellence, as evidenced by the accreditation from the Malaysian Qualifications Agency and the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia. accordionSections.Entry requirements: ACADEMIC MINIMUM ENTRY REQUIREMENTS MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS FOR ENTRY INTO A DENTAL PROGRAMME (MALAYSIAN QUALIFICATION FRAMEWORK, MQF LEVEL 6) A high level of academic attainment is expected. An understanding of science, in particular chemistry and biology, is central to the understanding of Dentistry. However, the Council recognizes the diversity of subjects taken by applicants and the contributions of those who have entered dental schools with other qualifications. All applicants shall have attained a level of competence in English to enable them to complete the course successfully. (For SEGi University, exemption is given for those international students from countries using English as their official language and also for those students who have done Foundation in Science with English as the medium of instruction). All applicants entering the dental programme via matriculation, foundation or pre-dental programme, except those with a degree qualification, STPM or A level shall have passed and attained a minimum of the following at School Certificate level or its equivalent: Examinations Requirements Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia (SPM) 5 Bs each in: Biology and Chemistry and Physics and Mathematics/ Additional Mathematics and Another subject (except Art/KSI) (KSI referring to the subjects of Kemanusiaan & Sastera Ikhtisas) General Certificate of Education Ordinary (“O”) levels 5 Bs each in: Biology and Chemistry; and Physics; and Mathematics/ Additional Mathematics; and Another subject (except Art/KSI) Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) B4 each in 3 subjects i.e. Biology; and Chemistry; and Physics; or Mathematics/Advanced Mathematics Note: Any applicants with School Certificates that are not mentioned in this guideline must refer to ‘The List of Entry Qualifications for International Students’ by Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA) for the purpose of qualification equivalency. A combination of SPM and O-Level results is allowed to fulfil the entry requirement as stated in Keputusan Mesyuarat Jawatankuasa Induk MQA-SPIPIT Bil. 1/2019 bertarikh 11 Mei 2009 and Keputusan Mesyuarat MQA Bil. 4/2019 bertarikh 27 Mei 2009 (Kompilasi Dasar Jaminan Kualiti Pendidikan Tinggi {2009 – 2020: Edisi Ketiga). UEC eligibility is only for admission to higher education programs in Private Higher Leaning Institution (IPTS) as stated in: Surat Pekeliling Ketua Pendaftar Institusi Pengajian Tinggi Swasta, Kementerian Pendidikan Malaysia Bil. 2/2004 – Kelayakan dan Kedudukan ’Unified Examination Certificate’ (UEC) dated 19 Mac 2004 No. Ruj: KP(JPS)5181/01/02/Jld.3(6) All applicants, except those with a degree qualification in sciences, arts or humanities, shall have passed and attained a minimum of the following at: Higher School Certificate level or its equivalent (STPM or A-Level) Sijil Tinggi Pelajaran Malaysia (STPM) 5 Bs each in: Biology and Chemistry and Physics and Mathematics/ Additional Mathematics and Another subject (except Art/KSI) (KSI referring to the subjects of Kemanusiaan & Sastera Ikhtisas) General Certificate of Education Advanced (“A”) levels 5 Bs each in: Biology and Chemistry; and Physics; and Mathematics/ Additional Mathematics; and Another subject (except Art/KSI) Note: Combination of A-Level or STAM and STPM is allowed to fulfil the entry requirement as stated in Keputusan Mesyuarat Jawatankuasa Induk MQA-SPIPTS Bil.1/2009 dated 1 May 2009 and Keputusan Mesyuarat MQA Bil. 4/2019 dated 27 May 2009 (Kompilasi Dasar Jaminan Kualiti Pendidikan Tinggi (2009 – 2020: Edisi Ketiga OR Matriculation, foundation or pre-medical programme or its equivalent (all applicants must fulfil the requirement as SPM/O-level or its equivalent) Matriculation or Foundation in Science or Pre- Medical course CGPA 3.0 (out of 4) in 3 subjects i.e. Biology; and Chemistry; and Physics or Mathematics And Provided the course is not less than 1 year in the same accredited institution. detail.overviewText: The Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) at SEGi University is a comprehensive five-year programme that prepares students for the respected and intricate field of dentistry. Recognised for fostering high standards of care and skill, SEGi’s BDS programme is crafted to shape competent and compassionate dental practitioners ready to impact oral health care significantly. Students commence their journey with early exposure to patient contact and clinical training, prioritising recognising and preventing oral diseases. The curriculum, underpinned by a problem-based learning approach, emphasises applying scientific knowledge in real clinical settings. SEGi’sstate-of-the-art facilities, including the SEGi Oral Health Centre, provide hands-on experience, ensuring graduates are well-equipped with the necessary practical skills. Emphasising a real-world approach, coursework and assignments derive from actual industry challenges, allowing students to engage with real patient cases. The programme is supported by international recognition from various medical councils and regulatory bodies, with students from over 16 countries contributing to a diverse learning environment. Accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency and Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia, SEGi University’s BDS graduates are renowned for their readiness to excel in both general practice and a wide range of dental specialities.

detail.overviewText: The Master of Social Science (M.Soc.Sc.) in Psychology programme offers a comprehensive and modern curriculum, equipping students with advanced skills and knowledge. The programme places strong emphasis on Research Methodology and Statistics, ensuring proficiency in data analysis and interpretation. Cutting-edge courses in advanced and emerging areas such as Digital Technologies in Psychology and Psychology of Entrepreneurship & Innovation prepare students for the future of the field. Ethical considerations are addressed through dedicated coursework in Ethics in Psychology. Students explore Advanced Cognitive Psychology and Personality Development and Assessment. Unique modules like Psychology of Life Coaching and Mentoring equip students for diverse career paths. The programme also includes Social and Cultural Psychology, enhancing understanding of psychological principles in diverse contexts. It culminates in a comprehensive research project, providing practical experience and enhancing research skills. APEL A entry recognises students’ prior work and life experiences for admission, and the curriculum incorporates industry experience, offering practical knowledge and real-world insights through internships and collaborations with leading organisations. detail.overviewText: The Bachelor of Hospitality Management (Honours) at SEGi University is your gateway to the vibrant and ever-evolving world of the hospitality industry. Spanning three enriching years, this programme is meticulously designed to equip you with the latest industry insights and prepare you to adapt seamlessly to the industry’s dynamic demands. Our comprehensive curriculum covers a wide array of subjects, from the fundamental principles of hospitality and business communication to specialised courses in catering operations, financial management, and tourism destination development. The programme’s robust foundation fosters innovative, creative, and critical thinking skills, essential for success in the hospitality sector. At SEGi, we go beyond conventional education by bringing the industry into the classroom. Through real industry projects, you’ll gain invaluable hands-on experience, guided by both seasoned lecturers and industry experts. This unique approach ensures that you graduate not only with theoretical knowledge but also with practical expertise. Furthermore, our diverse student community, representing over 90 nationalities, offers a truly international learning environment. Accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency and the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia, this programme opens doors to a plethora of opportunities within prestigious organisations across the globe. Embark on this transformative journey with us, where you can explore a myriad of career opportunities in hotels, restaurants, travel agencies, airlines, and more. Join us to become a leader in the thriving world of hospitality.

detail.overviewText: At SEGi University, we are proud to stand among the top 1.5% of universities worldwide, delivering a world-class education that nurtures future pharmacists to make a lasting impact on patients’ well-being while pursuing a rewarding career. Our Bachelor of Pharmacy (Hons) programme offers a holistic journey — from drug formulation to their application in disease prevention and treatment. Students gain not only scientific knowledge but also hands-on practical, clinical, and professional skills, ensuring they graduate as competent healthcare professionals ready for the future. SEGi provides the global & Industry-Driven Learning experience where real-world projects guided by industry practitioners occur through the ‘Industry into Classroom’ venture. At SEGi, the future pharmacists are exposed to opportunities beyond the borders of SEGi and Malaysia through global Open-Collaboration Opportunities. They work alongside international peers and experts, building networks that span continents. With representation from over 90 nationalities, SEGi provides a truly international learning environment, totally inclusive and diversified. The Bachelor of Pharmacy with Honours from SEGi is accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA), the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia and the Pharmacy Board of Malaysia. 100% Employability Rate — every graduate secures a career in pharmacy or related fields. With this unique degree, SEGi prepares you for various career pathways including community pharmacy, hospital and clinical pharmacy, pharmaceutical industry, academia, government and regulatory agencies, veterinary pharmacy, military pharmacy, and research. At SEGi University, you don’t just study pharmacy — you become part of a global brand in education, empowered to shape healthcare locally and internationally.

detail.overviewText: This research-driven master’s programme is designed for professionals and graduates in the medical, biomedical, and health sciences sectors who aspire to lead cutting-edge research and advance healthcare through evidence based innovation. You will begin by mastering advanced qualitative and quantitative research methods before undertaking a personalised research project under expert supervision. With flexible full-time or part-time pathways, you’ll work closely with supervisors to explore key issues in public health, pharmacology, pathology, or your chosen specialisation. The programme’s minimal coursework structure and strong academic support system provide an ideal foundation for PhD pathways and careers in clinical research, academia, and consultancy. Upon completion, you will be able to: Conduct independent, high-impact research that addresses real-world health challenges Design and execute projects with ethical rigour and scientific precision Apply both qualitative and quantitative methods in medical research Communicate findings for publication and policy application Contribute meaningfully to academia, healthcare, and research innovation Why Choose This Programme? Fully research-based with minimal coursework Broad specialisations from biomedical to public health Flexible study modes for working professionals Supervision by leading experts in the field Opportunities to publish and present research Strong progression pathways to PhD Industry and research institute collaboration

detail.overviewText: The Master of Accountancy (MAcc) programme at SEGi University is your pathway to a successful career in accounting. Specifically designed to provide an in-depth exploration of fundamental accounting principles, this programme equips students with the knowledge and skills required to excel in the field. Notably, it prepares students for CIMA (Chartered Institute of Management Accountants) examinations, opening doors to global opportunities. What sets our MAcc apart is its flexible learning format, tailor-made for working professionals. Delivered by experienced academics in small-class settings, students benefit from personalised support throughout their academic journey. The curriculum not only fosters technical expertise but also emphasises the importance of social, professional, and ethical responsibilities inherent in the accounting profession. Throughout the programme, students hone their communication and technological skills, vital for professional success. Additionally, the MAcc offers a comprehensive understanding of international accounting principles, preparing graduates for a globalised workforce. SEGi University’s commitment to adult learning, flexible timetabling, multi-campus access, and innovative industry integration ensures that MAcc graduates are well-prepared for diverse career paths in finance, including roles in financial and management accounting, taxation, auditing, investment, financial advising, banking, and stockbroking.

detail.overviewText: The Master of Education by Research at SEGi University empowers educators with essential research skills, preparing them for leadership roles in academia or industry. This unique programme focuses solely on research, facilitating professional development. SEGi University, a leader in adult learning, offers flexible timetabling to accommodate educators’ busy schedules and multi-campus access for a well-rounded education. The “Industry into Classroom” approach provides real-world project experience, bridging theory and practice. With a diverse student body representing over 90 nationalities, SEGi fosters a multicultural environment for networking and international exposure. Accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency and the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia, the programme meets high educational standards. Spanning two years, the curriculum covers key subjects such as “Research Methodology” and “Statistics and Data Analysis” in the first year. The second year focuses on project finalisation. Graduates are prepared for leadership roles in various educational settings, including children’s centers, extended schools, and childminding networks.

detail.overviewText: The Master of Science (Information Technology) at SEGi University is a visionary programme designed for those seeking to make substantial contributions to the field of IT. As a leader in adult learning, SEGi ensures a swift and comprehensive educational journey, offering flexible timetabling and access to multiple campuses. This programme is ideal for aspiring academicians, consultants, technopreneurs, and researchers aiming to excel in industrial R&D or within government-backed research entities. Distinguished by its ‘Industry into Classroom’ ethos, the programme transcends conventional academia, embedding real industry challenges into the curriculum. This innovative approach empowers students with practical experience under the guidance of academic and industry experts. Students from over 90 nationalities enrich the learning environment, fostering a global network and a diverse cultural understanding. Accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency and the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia, the Master of Science (Information Technology) equips graduates with the expertise to secure prominent roles in various sectors, from IT consultancy to business analysis, ensuring a future at the forefront of technological innovation.

This programme places a strong emphasis on analytical training tailored to individual specialisations, culminating in an applied final thesis. In the first year, students delve into three crucial modules, covering Theory of Knowledge, Advanced Research Methods and Design, and Research Proposal and Seminar. Following this foundation, you’ll engage in in-depth research and craft a comprehensive thesis under the guidance of an approved supervisor. Key selling points of this programme include SEGi University’s reputation as a leader in adult learning, an accelerated timeframe for completion, flexible timetabling, and multi-campus access. Moreover, SEGi’s unique ‘Industry into Classroom’ approach stands out, offering students the opportunity to work on real industry projects while being mentored by both academic experts and industry practitioners. detail.overviewText: The Master of Laws (LL.M) in Advanced Legal Practice at SEGi University is a forward-thinking postgraduate programme that propels legal professionals into the upper echelons of legal expertise. This one-year intensive course, accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency and the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia, is tailored to cultivate a deep understanding of legal practices and to develop robust skills necessary for a variety of legal careers. Students immerse themselves in eight core modules, with the flexibility to choose from ten diverse electives, such as Business Law & Practice, Advanced Banking Law, and Alternative Dispute Resolution, shaping a bespoke educational experience aligned with their professional goals. The curriculum is designed to foster advanced research and critical thinking skills, enabling graduates to navigate and address complex legal challenges across multiple domains. Incorporating the ‘Industry into Classroom’ initiative, the LL.M programme offers real-world legal project work under the guidance of seasoned lecturers and industry practitioners, ensuring an education that’s as practical as it is academic. With students from over 90 nationalities, SEGi University also provides an enriching multicultural environment for networking and global legal insight. Graduates are poised to excel as Contracts Directors, Corporate Secretaries, Legal Advisors, NGO Policy Counsel, Compliance Officers, and more, driving change and excellence in the legal field.

detail.overviewText: The Master of Accountancy (MAcc) programme at SEGi University is your pathway to a successful career in accounting. Specifically designed to provide an in-depth exploration of fundamental accounting principles, this programme equips students with the knowledge and skills required to excel in the field. Notably, it prepares students for CIMA (Chartered Institute of Management Accountants) examinations, opening doors to global opportunities. What sets our MAcc apart is its flexible learning format, tailor-made for working professionals. Delivered by experienced academics in small-class settings, students benefit from personalised support throughout their academic journey. The curriculum not only fosters technical expertise but also emphasises the importance of social, professional, and ethical responsibilities inherent in the accounting profession. Throughout the programme, students hone their communication and technological skills, vital for professional success. Additionally, the MAcc offers a comprehensive understanding of international accounting principles, preparing graduates for a globalised workforce. SEGi University’s commitment to adult learning, flexible timetabling, multi-campus access, and innovative industry integration ensures that MAcc graduates are well-prepared for diverse career paths in finance, including roles in financial and management accounting, taxation, auditing, investment, financial advising, banking, and stockbroking.

detail.overviewText: The Master of Accountancy (MAcc) programme at SEGi University is your pathway to a successful career in accounting. Specifically designed to provide an in-depth exploration of fundamental accounting principles, this programme equips students with the knowledge and skills required to excel in the field. Notably, it prepares students for CIMA (Chartered Institute of Management Accountants) examinations, opening doors to global opportunities. What sets our MAcc apart is its flexible learning format, tailor-made for working professionals. Delivered by experienced academics in small-class settings, students benefit from personalised support throughout their academic journey. The curriculum not only fosters technical expertise but also emphasises the importance of social, professional, and ethical responsibilities inherent in the accounting profession. Throughout the programme, students hone their communication and technological skills, vital for professional success. Additionally, the MAcc offers a comprehensive understanding of international accounting principles, preparing graduates for a globalised workforce. SEGi University’s commitment to adult learning, flexible timetabling, multi-campus access, and innovative industry integration ensures that MAcc graduates are well-prepared for diverse career paths in finance, including roles in financial and management accounting, taxation, auditing, investment, financial advising, banking, and stockbroking.

detail.overviewText: At SEGi University, we are proud to stand among the top 1.5% of universities worldwide, delivering a world-class education that nurtures future pharmacists to make a lasting impact on patients’ well-being while pursuing a rewarding career. Our Bachelor of Pharmacy (Hons) programme offers a holistic journey — from drug formulation to their application in disease prevention and treatment. Students gain not only scientific knowledge but also hands-on practical, clinical, and professional skills, ensuring they graduate as competent healthcare professionals ready for the future. SEGi provides the global & Industry-Driven Learning experience where real-world projects guided by industry practitioners occur through the ‘Industry into Classroom’ venture. At SEGi, the future pharmacists are exposed to opportunities beyond the borders of SEGi and Malaysia through global Open-Collaboration Opportunities. They work alongside international peers and experts, building networks that span continents. With representation from over 90 nationalities, SEGi provides a truly international learning environment, totally inclusive and diversified. The Bachelor of Pharmacy with Honours from SEGi is accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA), the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia and the Pharmacy Board of Malaysia. 100% Employability Rate — every graduate secures a career in pharmacy or related fields. With this unique degree, SEGi prepares you for various career pathways including community pharmacy, hospital and clinical pharmacy, pharmaceutical industry, academia, government and regulatory agencies, veterinary pharmacy, military pharmacy, and research. At SEGi University, you don’t just study pharmacy — you become part of a global brand in education, empowered to shape healthcare locally and internationally.

The curriculum, enriched by expert instruction and state-of-the-art facilities, covers vision sciences, clinical practice, and more, offering hands-on experience through industry projects integrated directly into the coursework. Graduates are well-prepared for a variety of roles in the optometry sector, equipped with the skills to thrive in an ever-evolving industry.

detail.overviewText: The Bachelor of Hospitality Management (Honours) at SEGi University is your gateway to the vibrant and ever-evolving world of the hospitality industry. Spanning three enriching years, this programme is meticulously designed to equip you with the latest industry insights and prepare you to adapt seamlessly to the industry’s dynamic demands. Our comprehensive curriculum covers a wide array of subjects, from the fundamental principles of hospitality and business communication to specialised courses in catering operations, financial management, and tourism destination development. The programme’s robust foundation fosters innovative, creative, and critical thinking skills, essential for success in the hospitality sector. At SEGi, we go beyond conventional education by bringing the industry into the classroom. Through real industry projects, you’ll gain invaluable hands-on experience, guided by both seasoned lecturers and industry experts. This unique approach ensures that you graduate not only with theoretical knowledge but also with practical expertise. Furthermore, our diverse student community, representing over 90 nationalities, offers a truly international learning environment. Accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency and the Ministry of Higher Education Malaysia, this programme opens doors to a plethora of opportunities within prestigious organisations across the globe. Embark on this transformative journey with us, where you can explore a myriad of career opportunities in hotels, restaurants, travel agencies, airlines, and more. Join us to become a leader in the thriving world of hospitality.

detail.overviewText: The Bachelor of Education (Hons) at SEGi University is a distinguished undergraduate program dedicated to nurturing aspiring educators, equipping them with the essential skills and knowledge for a fulfilling career in education. Throughout this programme, students delve into the foundational principles of education, psychology, curriculum development, and gain invaluable practical experience in real classrooms, preparing them to become highly effective educators. Graduates of this programme emerge with a profound understanding of teaching methodologies, technology integration, and diverse instructional strategies, poised to make a profound impact on their students’ intellectual growth and character development, thus shaping the future through education. detail.overviewText: The Bachelor of Computer Science (Honours) at SEGi University offers a 3-year programme with specialisations designed to prepare students for diverse career opportunities in the ever-evolving field of IT. Students can choose to specialise in one of four areas: Artificial Intelligence: Gain a deep understanding of AI, covering machine learning, natural language processing, robotics, and decision-making systems, along with practical applications and mathematical foundations. Cybersecurity: Develop robust technical and problem-solving skills to safeguard systems, networks, and data from cyber threats, with opportunities for professional certifications. Data Science: Delve into the multidisciplinary field of data science, extracting insights through statistical and computational methods, including data collection, analysis, modeling, and communication, with broad industry applications. SEGi University offers state-of-the-art facilities, collaboration with industry partners, and experienced academic faculty with industry backgrounds. Our unique “Industry into Classroom” approach provides students with real-life industry projects, offering a practical learning experience. With a diverse student community representing over 90 nationalities, SEGi University fosters international exposure and networking.
